exact_statement: For every strictly increasing sequence of positive moduli n_i and arbitrary residue classes a_i modulo n_i, determine whether the set of natural n such that for every i either n<n_i or n is not congruent to a_i modulo n_i must have a logarithmic density.
scope_notes: Official page checked 2026-08-25: OPEN, zero claimed proofs; the problem is a special case of #486.
Moduli are strictly increasing and each forbidden class starts only at its own modulus.
Existence in a summable-reciprocal or other restricted cohort is scoped progress only.
